name: Hitozuma Sentai Aisaiger Paipaipon! ~Chikyuu no Pinch da, Uchuujin Hitozuma Majo Shuurai!~
original_name: 人妻戦隊アイサイガー ぱいぱいポン! ～地球のピンチだ、宇宙人妻魔女襲来!～
source:
One day, the members of Aisaiger have been taken hostage by someone.... It's the work of Gramajo. They are under a spell practiced by Gramajo and attack innocent people in evil battle costumes. To get back their senses, you'll need to get rid of their battle costumes!! When Naotaro is at a loss what to do, Kyuji, Gramajo's husband, offers a help. Magic for Magic!! Will they be able to make it getting back their senses...?

[From ErogeShop]
